title: Union, Intersection, Difference Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Diya likes mango, apple, guava and banana. Meera likes apple, mango and grapes. Buy every fruit, only the ones both like, or the ones only Diya likes? Same two lists, three different answers. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 1, Sets) those three questions become the three set operations: union, intersection and difference.

You will watch A ∪ B build live (each shared element written only once), run the "is it in B too?" test that finds A ∩ B, pull two circles apart to meet disjoint sets, and strike out shared elements to get A − B. We compare A − B with B − A, split circle A into two pieces, work through the factors of 12 and 18 (and spot the HCF in the intersection), and look at the exam trap where students subtract numbers instead of removing elements. Two pause-and-think questions, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 Two fruit lists, three questions
0:36 Union: build A ∪ B live
1:16 Intersection: the "in B too?" test
1:50 Disjoint sets
2:06 Difference: A − B
2:35 A − B vs B − A
3:07 Circle A is two pieces
3:33 Worked example: factors of 12 and 18
4:20 Exam trap: set difference is not subtraction
4:38 Where it is asked
4:50 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:27 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 9): Complement of a Set. Everyone in class who did NOT ride a bicycle today is a set too.
